  let ready=false;for(let n=0;n<60&&Date.now()<setupDeadlineMs;n++){try{const h=await rpc('chain_getFinalizedHead',[],setupDeadlineMs);check(/^0x[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(h),'READINESS_HEAD');ready=true;break;}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TypeError&&e.message==='fetch failed'&&['ECONNREFUSED','UND_ERR_SOCKET'].includes(e.cause?.code)))throw e;await beforeDeadline(()=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,Math.min(1000,Math.max(1,setupDeadlineMs-Date.now()-1)))),setupDeadlineMs);}}check(ready&&Date.now()<setupDeadlineMs,'READINESS_TIMEOUT');const deadlineMs=Date.now()+60000;queryDeadline=deadlineMs;
  const pins=JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('./inputs.json',import.meta.url))),records={};for(const [p,sha] of Object.entries(pins.files)){check(p.startsWith('deliverables/')&&!p.split('/').includes('..'),'INPUT_PATH');const raw=readFileSync(new URL(p,ROOT));check(hash(raw)===sha,'INPUT_HASH');records[p]=p.endsWith('.bin')?raw:JSON.parse(raw);}
  const plan=records[pins.planPath];loaded=await beforeDeadline(()=>loadProvenFinancialContract({case:'loan',...plan.build}),deadlineMs);const build=JSON.parse(readFileSync(plan.build.receiptPath));const keys=Object.fromEntries(['accrue','initialize','settle'].map(n=>[n,readFileSync(build.assetsPath+'/keys/'+n+'.verifier')]));let tx;let deployInitialHex;try{tx=ledger.Transaction.deserialize('signature','proof','binding',records[pins.deployRawPath]);const deploy=[...tx.intents.values()].flatMap(i=>i.actions).find(a=>a.address===ADDRESS);check(deploy,'DEPLOY_ACTION');deployInitialHex=Buffer.from(deploy.initialState.serialize()).toString('hex');}finally{tx?.free?.();}
  Object.assign(out,await captureHistorical({rpc,rows:pins.rows,summaries:Object.fromEntries(pins.rows.map(r=>[r.stage,records[r.summaryPath]])),loaded,keys,deployInitialHex,deadlineMs}));check(Date.now()<deadlineMs,'QUERY_DEADLINE');
 }catch(e){out.status='UNKNOWN';out.failure={code:typeof e?.message==='string'&&/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,95}$/.test(e.message)?e.message:'PUBLIC_READBACK_FAILURE'};}
 finally{if(loaded){try{check(loaded.cleanup()?.loaderHooksRemoved===true,'LOADER_CLEANUP');out.loaderClosed=true;}catch{out.status='UNKNOWN';out.failure={code:'LOADER_CLEANUP'};}}if(queryDeadline&&Date.now()>=queryDeadline){out.status='UNKNOWN';out.failure={code:'QUERY_DEADLINE'};}out.totalQueries=reads;out.elapsedMs=Date.now()-started;}
 return out;
}
function retain(result){const bytes=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');check(bytes.length<=524288,'OUTPUT_BOUND');const fd=openSync(new URL('./probe-result.json',import.meta.url),constants.O_WRONLY|constants.O_CREAT|constants.O_EXCL|constants.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600);try{writeFileSync(fd,bytes);fsyncSync(fd);}finally{closeSync(fd);}const dir=openSync(new URL('.',import.meta.url),constants.O_RDONLY|constants.O_DIRECTORY);try{fsyncSync(dir);}finally{closeSync(dir);}}
if(process.argv[1]&&pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href===import.meta.url){const setupDeadlineMs=Number(process.argv[2]);const timer=setTimeout(()=>process.exit(2),180000);try{const result=await probe({setupDeadlineMs});retain(result);process.exitCode=result.status==='HISTORICAL_STATES_OBSERVED'?0:2;}finally{clearTimeout(timer);}}

# Proposed read-only LOCAL historical readback

Do not run before exact fresh GPT6/Grok source and resource approvals and a bound
execution-admission.json. The actual financial allocation remains consumed; this
is one independent public-state observation, zero transactions/proofs/DUST.

From the sp05-local-completion checkout, the sole proposed entry is:

`python3 deliverables/sp05-financial-integration-2026-09-09/local-command-execution-proposal-01/loan/historical-readback-01/execute-once.py`

The executor refuses existing attempt/result/unit names, verifies candidate,
actual reviews, installed SDK and retained public inputs, then requires20GiB
available RAM and4GiB free disk. It checks both original node/indexer images and
limits; the proof server must remain exited. It arms the original independent
finite timer before starting exactly node+indexer. Existing writable layers stay.

A single4GiB/no-swap/2CPU diagnostic gets only the remaining120s activation/setup
window and60s fixed-query phase. Its exact manager argv and absolute setup deadline
are retained before dispatch. RemainAfterExit retains terminal evidence. Capture
loaded active/exited actual ExecMainCode/ExecMainStatus and same startup InvocationID
before explicit stop; do not infer exit0 from unloaded defaults. Keep the independent
timer active through diagnostic stop and physical containment verification. Record
actual stop/cancel codes, startup cgroup absence, both containers exited and proof
server still exited before timer cancellation. Failed cleanup is not success.

Queries are exclusively local node RPC. Indexer starts as requested retained local
context and provides no substitute state/finality answer. The fixed four stages
are20455/20459/20463/20467 at the exact hashes in inputs.json. Four full native
states, all decoded fields, native balances and three verifier-key byte matches
per stage are required. Deploy bytes must equal the retained deployment's native
initial state. Missing/pruned/API errors stop without fallback or new financial
attempt. The response ceiling remains64KiB per request and5s, max77 requests
including at most60 readiness probes; fixed capture is17 requests within60s.
Normalized JSON RPC result records are retained, not claimed raw HTTP envelopes.

All diagnostics are public data. Original private logs, keys, wallets, contracts,
roles, password and snapshots are not read. The public plan draft supplies only
unchanged build options; its deadline0 is never used to launch a financial command.
Source tests use a prior public state with controlled transport, not new actual
historical bytes or the live services. Full financial acceptance remains pending
independent result reviews after successful actual readback.

END SOURCE

SOURCE /home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sp05-local-completion/deliverables/sp05-financial-integration-2026-09-09/local-command-execution-proposal-01/loan/root-native-check-01.mjs ORIGINAL_SHA256 107d80d032a7bd01e8d2d41563e4101489caa23208553378d265c343bcc89b31
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
const R='/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sp05-local-completion',D=R+'/deliverables/sp05-financial-integration-2026-09-09/local-command-execution-proposal-01/loan';
const {PINNED_NM}=await import(pathToFileURL(R+'/experiments/moriarty-midnight-financial/ledger/providers.mjs'));
const ledger=await import(pathToFileURL(PINNED_NM+'/@midnight-ntwrk/midnight-js-protocol/dist/ledger.mjs'));
const {decodeNativeFinancialTransaction}=await import(pathToFileURL(R+'/experiments/moriarty-midnight-financial/ledger/receipt.mjs'));
const j=p=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(p));const result=j(D+'/actual-run/integration-result.json');let dust=0n;const rows=[];
for(const s of result.driver.stages){const raw=readFileSync(D+'/actual-run/public-transactions/'+s.transaction.rawSha256+'.bin');const decoded=decodeNativeFinancialTransaction(raw,ledger);assert.deepEqual(decoded,s.transaction);assert(decoded.identifiers.includes(s.txId));dust+=BigInt(decoded.dustFee);rows.push({stage:s.circuitId,bytes:raw.length,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex'),identifiers:decoded.identifiers,inputSignaturesVerified:decoded.inputs.length,inputs:decoded.inputs,outputs:decoded.outputs,nativeActions:decoded.actions});}
assert.equal(dust,1200000000000004n);const settle=rows[3],init=rows[1];assert.equal(settle.inputs[0].intentHash,init.outputs[0].intentHash);assert.equal(settle.inputs[0].outputNo,init.outputs[0].offerIndex);assert.equal(settle.inputs[0].owner,init.outputs[0].owner);assert.equal(settle.inputs[0].value,init.outputs[0].value);assert.equal(BigInt(settle.outputs[0].value)+BigInt(settle.outputs[1].value),BigInt(settle.inputs[0].value));assert.equal(settle.outputs[0].value,'533972602');
const out={status:'PASS',scope:'Offline exact native roundtrip/IDs/input signature/effect decoding and UTXO linkage; not independent proof verification or RPC authentication',stages:rows,totalNativeDustDebitSpeck:dust.toString()};writeFileSync(D+'/root-native-transactions-01.json',JSON.stringify(out,null,2)+'\n');console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',nativeTransactions:4,signatureVerifiedInputs:1,totalNativeDustDebitSpeck:dust.toString()}));

END SOURCE
